blocks.text: Spectroscopy woh ilm hai jo electromagnetic radiation aur maadde (matter) ke aapas ke amal (interaction) se banne wale spectra ko banane, naapne aur samajhne se mutaliq hai. Spectrum se atomic aur molecular energy levels, molecules ki shakal (geometry), molecules ke aapas ke amal aur chemical bonds ki qisam ke bare mein maloomat milti hai. Spectroscopy se sample mein kisi khaas cheez ki miqdar bhi naapi ja sakti hai (quantitative analysis, yani kitna hai) ya sirf kisi na-maloom sample ki pehchan ki ja sakti hai (qualitative analysis, yani kya hai).

Kisi cheez ki chemical composition (kis cheez se bani hai) emission aur absorption spectra se maloom ki ja sakti hai. Har element spectral lines ka apna alag namoona (pattern) banata hai. Koi do elements aik jaisi lines nahi dete, is liye elements ko un ke atomic spectra se pehchana ja sakta hai. Emission line spectra har element ke liye ungliyon ke nishan (fingerprint) ki tarah alag hote hain.

Maslan hydrogen visible spectrum ke surkh (red) hisse mein 656 nm par tez lines deta hai. Sodium jalane par 589 nm par peele hisse ki tez lines ki wajah se khaas peela shola nazar aata hai. Mercury jalane par us ki zyada tar emission lines 450 nm se neeche hoti hain, jo khaas neeli roshni deti hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Atomic spectra se astronomers (falkiyat ke mahireen) sitaron ki chemical composition bhi maloom karte hain. In ajram (celestial bodies) ki chhori hui roshni ka tajziya kar ke scientists kainaat ke raaz khol sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ko us ke emission spectrum se kyun pehchana ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Har element ke apne energy levels hain, is liye us ki spectral lines ka pattern sirf usi ka hota hai, bilkul fingerprint ki tarah.

items: Spectroscopy: radiation aur matter ke interaction ka mutala.
Line spectra elements ke fingerprint hain: H 656 nm, Na 589 nm, Hg 450 nm se neeche.
